verdict.rationale: Plausible publishes a dedicated Community Edition self-hosting guide (plausible-docs-2), and community members confirm long-term successful self-hosted use (plausible-comm-5, plausible-comm-13), satisfying the self-host axis for an AI-native/open-source-minded user. Some hands-on feedback notes the self-hosted setup is non-trivial due to ClickHouse dependency (plausible-comm-15), a real but secondary caveat. missing for 10: independent benchmarking of self-host setup difficulty/resource requirements beyond one anecdotal complaint, and more detailed first-party deployment docs (e.g., scaling guidance).
